QueryString:
SELECT 'dim_customer' AS tabla, COUNT(*) AS registros FROM public.dim_customer
UNION ALL SELECT 'dim_date', COUNT(*) FROM public.dim_date
UNION ALL SELECT 'dim_event_type', COUNT(*) FROM public.dim_event_type
UNION ALL SELECT 'dim_geography', COUNT(*) FROM public.dim_geography
UNION ALL SELECT 'dim_product', COUNT(*) FROM public.dim_product
UNION ALL SELECT 'dim_sales_channel', COUNT(*) FROM public.dim_sales_channel
UNION ALL SELECT 'fct_sales', COUNT(*) FROM public.fct_sales
UNION ALL SELECT 'fct_navigation_events', COUNT(*) FROM public.fct_navigation_events
UNION ALL SELECT 'fct_reviews', COUNT(*) FROM public.fct_reviews
ORDER BY tabla;
